text:
incident-bot: PAGE: High error rate on prompt-routing (route-v2 canary) — 5xx spike from 20% canary (p95 latency ↑ 2x). dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example.com/d/abc123/prompt-routing?orgId=1

lina: oncall here, seeing alerts. marking SEV2 for now. what was rolled?

kevin: rolled route-v2 as canary at 08:11 UTC to 20% (traffic split). no code changes, routing config + new endpoint handler.

cheng: can we get a few logs and sample request IDs? I'm seeing 502s with upstream connection reset.

lina: grabbing logs ->
```
[08:19:02 UTC] route-v2 worker-12 ERROR request_id=req_7f3a status=502 backend_error="upstream reset" latency_ms=312
[08:19:04 UTC] route-v2 worker-07 ERROR request_id=req_7f3b status=503 model_conn_timeout
[08:19:10 UTC] route-v2 worker-03 WARN cache_miss prompt_hash=0x9f8a
```

maya: customer-impact check: PagerDuty shows 3 customers with increased error rates; one premium customer opened a ticket at 08:22 UTC.

olivia: @lina FYI support triage: ticket #CUST-992 flagged as "generation failing" for 5 requests.

lina: given 20% canary and failures concentrated on route-v2, propose kill-switch for the feature flag and immediate rollback of canary. any objections?

sam: +1 kill-switch now. we should also ensure route-v1 is fully healthy before shifting. quick health check:
```
> curl -sS https://route-v1.redwood.example.com/health | jq '.'
{"status":"ok","latency_p95_ms":84}
```

kevin: I'm on it. flipping feature flag `prompt_routing.v2_enabled` -> false in LaunchDarkly. Command I used: `ldctl toggle prompt_routing.v2_enabled --env=prod --value=false --actor=kevin`

deploy-bot: deploy activity: feature-flag-toggle by kevin at 08:24:13 UTC.

lina: also issuing dynamic route fallback to force all traffic to route-v1 while we investigate: `redwoodctl routing set-default --route route-v1` (this is a controlled emergency override).

deploy-bot: routing override applied, previous default route backed up to default_backup_20260315_0824.

cheng: monitoring logs now. early signal: error rate on route-v2 dropping (as expected), overall 5xx across prod decreasing.

maya: pinging affected customer with interim note: "We observed elevated errors for a small subset of requests. We have reverted the new routing and are monitoring. Apologies; will follow up with postmortem."

olivia: sent. ticket updated. customer asked if this caused any data exposure — replied no, only transient failures.

sam: check for configuration mismatch: route-v2 uses new upstream pool `inference-pool-v2` with different keepalive & connection limits. looking at pool metrics:
```
pool=inference-pool-v2 connections_open=120 max_conn=128 conn_errors=18
pool=inference-pool-v1 connections_open=45 max_conn=256 conn_errors=2
```

cheng: that explains resets under load. also seeing occasional timeout on initial kv-cache warm for route-v2 which increased latency and likely led to upstream timeouts.

kevin: ack. plan: keep flag off, revert route config in main branch (ops patch) and add connection tuning to pool v2, then rehearse a smaller canary.

lina: handoff plan — I'll keep monitoring for 30m then hand off to cheng for postmortem and remediation. cheng, you take next oncall shift?

cheng: taking handoff at 08:54 UTC. will collate metrics, stack traces, and an initial RCA draft.

maya: schedule bridge for 09:15 UTC postmortem with ENG, SRE, Product, and Support. calendar invite sent.

kevin: deploying quick config rollback patch to disable v2 pool tuning that was added in the canary: `git revert d4f3a2b && ./deploy.sh --staged` (running now).

deploy-bot: CI passed, rolling patch to prod at 08:33 UTC, small traffic-limited rollout.

lina: confirming customer-impact summary for oncall log: 3 customers affected, ~0.02% of total requests, error spike window 08:18–08:26 UTC, immediate mitigation: feature flag kill-switch + routing override, status: stabilized.

olivia: note for postmortem: ensure customer comms include timeline and next steps.

cheng: collecting traces and will attach to postmortem: span ids, sample requests, and pool metrics.

lina: closing paging loop — will update this thread after the 09:15 bridge. thanks everyone. :heart: :shield:

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to monitoring. SEV2 -> monitoring at 08:39 UTC.

deploy-bot: auto-note: rollback completed, feature flag state=off, routing default=route-v1 (override).

cheng: picking up postmortem action items: (1) add connection limit safety checks on pool creation, (2) add kv-cache warm healthcheck before canary increase, (3) better pre-rollout config review for upstream pool params.

maya: assigned followups and AOs in postmortem doc.

lina: handing off to cheng now for the long-running fixes. thanks all — incident resolved for oncall.

cheng: acknowledged handoff. will own the writeup.

olivia: drafted customer follow-up to be sent after RCA: short summary + ETA for fixes.

lina: marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
